text: Tools. gap/plateau5_lib.g builds, for a presentation $\Gamma$ on $x_1..x_d$, the group $M=\Gamma/\gamma_{c+1}\Gamma''$ (nq), a projection $\varphi$ of $\gamma_c(M)$ onto one cyclic factor of its Smith basis on which $w\neq1$, and $G=M/\ker\varphi$ written as a presentation (the relators, $[U,V]$ for left-normed $U,V$ of weights $\ge2$ with total weight $\le c$, $C\,c_0^{-e_C}$ for the left-normed $C$ of weight $c$, and the commutators of weight $c+1$), in the JSON of gpu/howell_gpu.py. The structure of $G$ (class, $G''=1$, $\gamma_k/\gamma_{k+1}$, torsion-free ranks for the Quillen certificate, $|w|$) is read off the pcp quotient $M/\ker\varphi$; the second nq run on the written presentation (as in gap/plateau.g) is optional, since nq overflows (CombiCollect) on these exponents. gap/plateau5_cands.g holds the families, scripts/plateau5_scan.py runs GAP and the closure, gpu/modal_c5.py runs both on Modal (GAP 4.14 + nq on a CPU container, the closure on an A100 80 GB), scripts/gap5.sh runs GAP in Docker locally. howell_gpu.py plateau now takes any input and any number of tests (test_names); the CPU reference is compared only for the default input. random and plateau --n 4 5 6 on the CPU still pass against gpu/reference.json.

text: Which relators of (3.12) matter ($n=6$, all certified). Dropping the fourth relator $x_5^{1024}d_2^{16}$ loses $w\in D_6$; dropping any one of the other five ($d_5^{2048}$, $d_1^{16}$, $d_2^{128}$ and the two top relators) keeps it, and so does dropping all five at once. Without $x_5$ altogether $w\notin D_6$; without $d_5^{16}$ in the second relator $w=1$. The free generator $x_6$ can be replaced by $x_3$ ($t=[x_4,x_3]$): five generators, $w\in D_6$. So the class-4 plateau survives on five generators with four relators: $$x_1^8d_2d_3^4,\quad x_2^{64}d_1^{-1}d_3^{-16}d_5^{16},\quad x_3^{16384}d_1^{-4}d_2^{16},\quad x_5^{1024}d_2^{16}, \qquad d_i=[x_4,x_3,x_i].$$
